answer_4.quote: We carried out a human survey to compare the ease of understanding and the utility of the explanations obtained by LIME and LENs.
answer_4.guideline: The survey presents respondents with a sample input, prediction, and explanations from LIME and LEN p , and asks them to rate ease of understanding, identify features to ignore to improve the classifier, identify the more general classifier, and rate ease of use for these tasks.
criteria: ability to identify feature to ignore
ability to identify more general classifier
